obligations.summary: Providers must ensure their high-risk AI systems comply with the requirements set out in Section 2 of the AI Act.
Providers must indicate their name, registered trade name or trade mark, and contact address on the high-risk AI system, or where not possible, on its packaging or accompanying documentation.
exceptions: Where indication on the system itself is not possible, the information may appear on its packaging or accompanying documentation.

obligations.summary: Providers must have a quality management system in place that complies with Article 17.
Providers must keep the technical documentation referred to in Article 18.
Providers must, when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as referred to in Article 19.
exceptions: Obligation applies only when the logs are under the provider's control.

obligations.summary: Providers must ensure that their high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 43 prior to being placed on the market or put into service.
Providers must draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47.

Providers must affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system, or where not possible, on its packaging or accompanying documentation, to indicate conformity with the Regulation in accordance with Article 48.
exceptions: Where affixing the CE marking on the system itself is not possible, it may be placed on its packaging or accompanying documentation.

obligations.summary: Providers must comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1).
Providers must take the necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20.
Providers must, upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2.
exceptions: Obligation is triggered only upon a reasoned request from a national competent authority.

obligations.summary: Providers must ensure that their high-risk AI systems comply with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882.
